notes: Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention: bank 't' = rows a-e and bank 'b' = rows f-j. In the image, rows a-e are the lower half and rows f-j the upper half.
The potentiometer straddles the centre gap. Its two outer legs are in column 10 and column 12 (rows a-e side). Its middle (wiper) leg is in column 11 (rows f-j side).
The black wire goes to one outer pin (GND) and the red wire to the other outer pin (5V). Because the pot is symmetric, GND and VCC could be swapped.
The yellow wire goes from the wiper column to A0. The image shows the wire at the top of column 11, so I placed it at row g. The exact row within the strip is an assumption.
The wire holes are in the same column strip as the pot legs. The image doesn't show the exact row, so the rows used for them are assumptions (row d for the black and red wires).
The Uno has two GND pins in its power header. I used GND.1 for the black wire.
The Arduino is assumed to be powered over USB, which the manual doesn't show, so no USB cable part is included.
